content: Ogey Baynda Maado Koshshenna
Ta ishatoo! Intte bonchchettida Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa ammanizayta gidida mala ase bessontta ogera maaddofte.

Worqqa yiich biradhdhen aaththidi lo7o may7o may7ida asi intte shiiqizaso yiikko hessaththoka qita may7o may7idaadey he shiiqizasoza yiikko qasseka hara qita may7o may7ida manqo asi gelikko lo7o may7idayssa dumma bonchcho bonchchidi, «Nees bessiza lo7o uttizaso hessa beya» giidi hankko manqoza qasse, «Ne heen hessan eqqa; woykko haa ya; ta garsan wugen utta» intte giikko,
intte intte giddon bessontta maado ooththeeta gidekketii? Qasseka intte iita qofan oykettida iita pirda pirdizayta gidekketii?
Ta siiqo ishatoo! Ane siyite; istti ammanon dureta gidana mala Xoossi bana dosizaytas hidota isttas immida kawoteththaa istti laattana mala hayssa ha alamezan diza manqota dooribeennee?
Intte qasse manqota kawushsheeta; inttena waayisizay dureta gidettennee? Inttena pirdaso goochchizay istta gidettennee?
Inttenan xeygettida bonchcho Xoossaa sunth zigirzayti istta gidettennee?
Geeshsha Maxaafan, «Ne lagge ne hu7e mala siiqa» geetetti xaafettida kawo wogaa intte polikko lo7o ooththeeta.
Intte bessontta maado maaddiko nagara ooththeeta; wogaa sinththankka intte woga yedhdhidaade gidi qoodettana.
Gaasoykka wogaa ubbaa polizaadey qasseka wogappe issineyn dhuphettiza asi ubbaaka mooridaade mala qoodettees.
«Laymatoppa» gidaadey izikka zaaridi, «Wodhoppa» gides. Ne laymatontta aggikokka neni as wodhikko wogappe aadhdhidaade gidaasa.
Intte haasaya haasayshe woykko issi miish ooththishe inttena xillisiza asa mala gidite.
Gaasoykka maaronttay wurikka maaroy baynda pirdettana; maaroy pirda Xoonees.
Ammanonne Ooso
Ta ishatoo! Issi asi taas ammanoy dees giikko qasse ooson bessonttaade gidikko iza ay maaddanee? Hessa mala ammanoy iza ashshanee?

Ane qopite; issi ishay woykko issi michchiya may7oy woykko mizayssi baynda aggiko inttefe issaadey, «Intte saron biite! Inttena meeggofo! Kallite!» giikko istta ashos koshshizayssa immontta aggiko ay maaddanee?
Hessaththoka oosoy baynda ammanoykka baas hayqqidayssa.
Gido attiin issaadey, «Taas oosoy dees; nees ammanoy dees; neni ne ammano oosoppe shaakkada tana bessa; ta qasse ta ammano ooson nena bessana» giikko
ne, «Issi Xoossi dizayssa ammanaasa» hessika lo7o; daydanththatikka hessa mala ammaneettessinne keehi kokkoreettes.
Nenoo eeyazoo! Oosoy baynda ammanos go7ay bayndayssa eranaas markka koyay?
Nu aawaa Abrahaamey ba naa Yisaaqa yarshizasoza bolla shiishshida wode ooson xillibeennee?
Hessan ba ammanoza oosora gaththi ooththizayssa ne beyaasa; ammanoykka ooson polettides.
«Abrahaamey Xoos ammanides; he ammanoy izas xilloteththan qoodettides» giza maxaafaa qaalay polettides; izikka Xoossi dosidaade geetettides.
Hessa gishshas asi ammanon xalla gidontta oosonkka xillizayssa intte beyeeta.
Hessaththoka layman diza Era7aaba kiitetti bida asata mokka ekkada hara ogera moyza yeddida gishshas ba ooson xillabeekkee?
Shemppofe shaakettida ashoy hayqeth gidida mala oosoppeka shaakettida ammanoy hayqeththa.
